simple.meaning: properly, a hard breather , i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and a bird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תַּנְשֶׁמֶת (H8580) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תַּנְשֶׁמֶת (tanshemeth) means properly, a hard breather , i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and a bird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen First listed occurrence: Deut 14 16.
